name: Parkway Shenton
summary: GP clinic network linked to Parkway hospitals — practical for insured families who want a clear private pathway.
body: Parkway Shenton clinics pair naturally with Mount Elizabeth / Gleneagles / Parkway East pathways for many corporate plans. Verify your insurer’s panel list rather than assuming every Parkway site bills identically. Use a clinic near home for ordinary illness and know which private hospital A&E your plan prefers after hours. Good fit when you want private-speed primary care without assembling a random clinic from Google Maps on day three.
